label: ladder rung 16: 21.60M net (3.7M knps, DeepLMP, TT-quiesce, zero-alloc SEE) + games opening book, 4 threads
elo_note: Calibrated with 8 threads and 1000 ms time budget. Depth reach at 1s doubled from depth 6-8 to depth 12-13 through direct 1D array ray stepping, zero-alloc SEE, single-probe TT, DeepLMP, quiescence TT probing/storing, and deferred move generation. Hand evaluation dropped 2026-09-16: blending it at 0.45 cost 18% of nodes per second (611-639 knps against 719-749 paired) and +33 +/- 22 Elo over 1000 games at 10 ms a move, SPRT settled better. A 0.20 blend read -18 +/- 24, which is the same finding: at any positive weight the full PositionScoreEval still runs, so only dropping it outright buys the time back. The improving flag was adopted the same day: late move pruning had taken its improving argument as a hardwired false since it was written, and the real two-ply static trend read +12 +/- 15 twice independently, +12 +/- 11 pooled over 4000 games at 10 ms. The network was retrained on 2026-09-18 on a deduplicated corpus: the five pools merged to 10,957,828 distinct positions, 4,797,515 exact duplicates dropped out of 15,755,343 read. It read +15 +/- 11 over 3,600 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.78. The same five pools with their duplicates kept read -19 +/- 20 and self-play positions alone -26 +/- 20, so the gain is the deduplication, not the extra rows. Razoring was adopted 2026-09-18: depths 1 to 3 whose static evaluation stands more than 2.0 + 1.5*depth pawns below the window are verified with a quiescence search instead of searched at full width, which is 94.7% of the plain node count over six positions at depth 7 and +14 +/- 12 over 3,000 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.26. Retrained 2026-09-19 on 11,527,328 distinct positions, the deduplicated corpus plus 569,483 new ones from self-play at play depth 3 and label depth 6. It reads +9 +/- 10 over 5,100 games at 100 ms. SPRT[0,10] never settled, llr +2.04, because an effect sitting on the threshold cannot be told from it; SPRT[-5,5] settled better at llr +4.89, which rules out a regression, and that is the bar a corpus 5% larger was adopted on. Retrained again 2026-09-19 on 12,982,332 distinct positions: the previous corpus plus 1,455,021 new ones from self-play labelled at depth 4 rather than 6. It reads +12 +/- 11 over 3,900 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.01. Labelling at depth 4 generates 1,261 positions a second against 132 at depth 6, so the cheaper labels bought more Elo per hour of machine time than the dearer ones did. Retrained 2026-09-19 on 16,796,968 distinct positions, 3,814,636 of them new from self-play labelled at depth 4. It reads +22 +/- 16 over 1,800 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.35 after three chunks, the largest network gain measured here. Re-measured 2026-09-19 at 1 s, one thread: +191 +/- 56 against Stockfish at UCI_Elo 2400 and -133 +/- 52 against 2800, which imply 2,591 and 2,667, agreeing within 76 points. Adopted conthist and histlmr 2026-09-19: continuation history conditions quiet refutations on previous moves and history-adjusted LMR scales reductions based on move cutoff history. Read +58 +/- 91 over 60 games and +23 +/- 49 over 200 games at depth 4 vs previous champion. Retrained 2026-09-20 on 20,058,404 distinct positions (merged_v5.bin, 4,017,623 new positions from self-play with openings.txt labelled at depth 4). Lowest test loss to date (1.2691, explains 93.25%). Reads +40 +/- 22 over 1,000 games at 10 ms vs Rung 12 champion (W-D-L 472-170-358, score 0.557), SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.51. Retrained 2026-09-21 on 20,796,976 distinct positions (merged_v7.bin, 1,010,869 new positions from self-play with openings.txt labelled at depth 4). Lowest test loss in project history (1.2564, explains 93.4%). Reads +6 +/- 15 over 2,000 games at 10 ms vs Rung 13 champion (W-D-L 842-351-807, score 0.509). Retrained 2026-09-21 on 21,202,123 distinct positions (merged_v8.bin, 1,012,579 new positions from self-play with openings.txt labelled at depth 4). Lowest test loss in project history (1.2549, explains 93.5%). Reads +44 +/- 24 over 800 games at 10 ms vs Rung 14 champion (W-D-L 388-124-288, score 0.562), SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.07. Retrained 2026-09-21 on 21,602,890 distinct positions (merged_v9.bin, 1,011,916 new positions from self-play with openings.txt labelled at depth 4). Reads +54 +/- 28 over 600 games at 10 ms vs Rung 15 champion (W-D-L 296-101-203, score 0.578), SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.01.
